export type PointerType =

    | 'pointerExit'
    | 'pointerDown'
    | 'pointerUp'
    | 'pointerMove'

--- Represents a pointer interaction event containing position and pointer id.
declare extern type PointerEvent with

    --- The position of the pointer in local coordinates.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerDown(self: RenderInstance, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     local localPos = event.position - Vector.xy(self.x, self.y)
    ---     local localEvent = PointerEvent.new(event.id, localPos)
    ---     local hit = self.instance:pointerDown(localEvent)
    ---     if hit ~= 0 then
    ---       print(
    ---         string.format(
    ---           'Local hit at (%.1f, %.1f)',
    ---           localEvent.position.x,
    ---           localEvent.position.y
    ---         )
    ---       )
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    position: Vector

    --- The unique identifier for the pointer.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerDown(self: RenderInstance, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     local localPos = event.position - Vector.xy(self.x, self.y)
    ---     local localEvent = PointerEvent.new(event.id, localPos)
    ---     local hit = self.instance:pointerDown(localEvent)
    ---     if hit ~= 0 then
    ---       print(localEvent.id)
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    id: number

    --- The type of event (pointerDown, pointerUp, click, pointerEnter, pointerMove, etc).
    type: PointerType

    --- Consumes the event. Call it on every event a script owns -- the press,
    --- each move of a drag, and the release -- or the event keeps travelling
    --- outward and an enclosing hit target claims the gesture. A
    --- `ScrollConstraint` viewport is the usual one: without this, dragging a
    --- control inside a scroll view scrolls the view instead.
    ---
    --- The argument inverts. Bare `hit()` is opaque and stops there;
    --- `hit(true)` marks this target translucent, so the event continues to
    --- whatever is behind it.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerDown(self: PointerExample, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     local hit = self.instance:pointerDown(event)
    ---     if hit ~= 0 then
    ---       -- Mark as handled but still allow translucent targets behind to receive it.
    ---       event:hit(true)
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    hit: (self: PointerEvent, isTranslucent:boolean?) -> ()
end


declare PointerEvent: {

    --- Creates a new `PointerEvent` with the given id and position.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerDown(self: RenderInstance, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     local localPos = event.position - Vector.xy(self.x, self.y)
    ---     local localEvent = PointerEvent.new(event.id, localPos)
    ---     local hit = self.instance:pointerDown(localEvent)

    ---       print(
    ---         string.format(
    ---           'Local hit at (%.1f, %.1f)',
    ---           localEvent.position.x,
    ---           localEvent.position.y
    ---         )
    ---       )
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    new: @checked (id: number, position: Vector) -> PointerEvent,
}

    buttons: { number }

--- Represents a node in the hierarchy, providing transform properties and
--- access to parent and child nodes.
declare extern type NodeReadData with

    --- The local position of the node.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     node.position = Vector.xy(199, 299)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    position: Vector

    --- The local rotation of the node in radians.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     node.rotation = math.rad(45)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    rotation: number

    --- The local scale of the node.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     node.scale = Vector.xy(1.4, 2)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    scale: Vector

    --- The read-only world transform of the node.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     local wt = node.worldTransform
    ---     print("world xx:", wt.xx, "xy:", wt.xy)
    ---     print("world yx:", wt.yx, "yy:", wt.yy)
    ---     print("world tx:", wt.tx, "ty:", wt.ty)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    worldTransform: Mat2D

    --- The x-coordinate of the local position.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     node.x = 100
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    x: number

    --- The y-coordinate of the local position.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     node.y = 200
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    y: number

    --- The x component of the local scale.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     node.scaleX = 2
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    scaleX: number

    --- The y component of the local scale.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     node.scaleY = 2
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    scaleY: number

    --- If node is a Path, paint trait is available with paint data
    ---
    --- (Coming soon)
    paint: Paint?

    --- If node is a Path, returns the node as `PathData`.
    --- ```lua
    --- function pointerDown(self: PaintInstance, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     local myPath = self.instance:node('MyPath')
    ---     if myPath then
    ---       local path = myPath:asPath()
    ---       if path then
    ---         local cmd: PathCommand = path[1]
    ---         print(cmd.type) -- moveTo
    ---       end
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function asPath(self):  PathData?

    --- If node is a ShapePaint (Fill or Stroke), returns node as `Paint`
    ---
    --- (Coming soon)
    function asPaint(self):  Paint?
end

--- Represents a node in the hierarchy, providing transform properties and
--- access to parent and child nodes.
declare extern type NodeData extends NodeReadData with

    --- Updates the node’s position, rotation, and scale from the given world
    --- transform.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Root')
    ---   if node then
    ---     local m = Mat2D.withTranslation(100, 100)
    ---     node:decompose(m)
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    function decompose(self, worldTransform:Mat2D): ()

    --- The node’s children.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     local hipsFirstChild = node.children[1]
    ---     print(hipsFirstChild)
    ---     local m = Mat2D.withTranslation(100, 100)
    ---
    ---     if hipsFirstChild then
    ---       hipsFirstChild:decompose(m)
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    children: { NodeData }

    --- The parent of the node, or nil if it has none.
    --- ```lua
    --- if self.instance then
    ---   local node = self.instance:node('Hips')
    ---   if node then
    ---     local hipsParent = node.parent
    ---     local m = Mat2D.withTranslation(100, 100)
    ---     if hipsParent then
    ---       hipsParent:decompose(m)
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```
    parent: NodeData?
end

export type Animation = {

    --- Advances the animation by the given time in seconds. Returns true if the
    --- animation hasn't reached its end. If the animation is set to loop or ping
    --- pong, it will always return true
    --- ```lua
    --- type AnimationExample = {
    ---   -- Artboard input, assigned in the Rive editor by the designer
    ---   character: Input<Artboard<nil>>,
    ---
    ---   -- The live instance and its animation
    ---   artboardInstance: Artboard<nil>?,
    ---   anim: Animation?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: AnimationExample, context: Context): boolean
    ---   self.artboardInstance = self.character:instance()
    ---
    ---   if self.artboardInstance then
    ---     self.anim = self.artboardInstance:animation('Idle')
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function advance(self: AnimationExample, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.anim and self.artboardInstance then
    ---     -- Advance the animation to apply keyframe values to the artboard
    ---     self.anim:advance(seconds * 2)
    ---     -- Advance the artboard with 0 to propagate changes without double-counting time
    ---     self.artboardInstance:advance(0)
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function draw(self: AnimationExample, renderer: Renderer)
    ---   if self.artboardInstance then
    ---     renderer:save()
    ---     self.artboardInstance:draw(renderer)
    ---     renderer:restore()
    ---   end
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<AnimationExample>
    ---   return {
    ---     character = late(),
    ---     artboardInstance = nil,
    ---     anim = nil,
    ---     init = init,
    ---     advance = advance,
    ---     draw = draw,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    advance: (self: Animation, seconds: number) -> boolean,

    --- set the animation time in seconds
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AnimationExample, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.anim and self.artboardInstance then
    ---     -- Set the animation to a specific time in seconds
    ---     self.anim:setTime(0.3)
    ---     -- Advance the artboard with 0 to propagate changes without double-counting time
    ---     self.artboardInstance:advance(0)
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    setTime: (self: Animation, time: number) -> (),

    --- set the animation time in frames
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AnimationExample, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.anim and self.artboardInstance then
    ---     -- Set the animation to a specific frame
    ---     self.anim:setTimeFrames(3)
    ---     -- Advance the artboard with 0 to propagate changes without double-counting time
    ---     self.artboardInstance:advance(0)
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    setTimeFrames: (self: Animation, frames: number) -> (),

    --- set the animation time as a percentage of the duration
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AnimationExample, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.anim and self.artboardInstance then
    ---     -- Set the animation to a specific percentage of the duration.
    ---     self.anim:setTimePercentage(.5)
    ---     -- Advance the artboard with 0 to propagate changes without double-counting time
    ---     self.artboardInstance:advance(0)
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    setTimePercentage: (self: Animation, percentage: number) -> (),

    --- The duration of the animation.
    --- ```lua
    --- function advance(self: AnimationExample, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.anim
    ---     print(self.anim.duration)
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    duration: number,
}

--- The kind of a custom property on a Drawable.
export type DrawablePropertyKind = "number" | "boolean" | "string" | "color" | "enum" | "trigger"

--- What a custom property is read by. Get one from `artboard:propertyKey`
--- once, in `init`, and keep it: resolving a name scans the file's name
--- table, reading by key does not.
export type PropertyKey = number

--- A drawable that carries custom properties, handed to the visitor of
--- `artboard:draw(renderer, visitor)`. It is only valid inside that visitor
--- call.
export type Drawable = {
    --- The custom number property of this key, nil when there is none.
    number: (self: Drawable, key: PropertyKey) -> number?,
    --- The custom boolean property of this key, nil when there is none.
    boolean: (self: Drawable, key: PropertyKey) -> boolean?,
    --- The custom color property of this key, nil when there is none.
    color: (self: Drawable, key: PropertyKey) -> Color?,
    --- The custom string property of this key, nil when there is none.
    string: (self: Drawable, key: PropertyKey) -> string?,
    --- Every custom property on the drawable. For tooling and debugging:
    --- the editor and rive-cli have it, a shipping runtime does not, so do
    --- not call it from a script you ship.
    properties: (self: Drawable) -> { { name: string, kind: DrawablePropertyKind } },
    --- Draws the drawable under the renderer's current state.
    draw: (self: Drawable, renderer: Renderer) -> (),
}

--- Represents a Rive artboard instance, providing drawing, advancing,
--- interaction handling, and access to named nodes and data.
export type Artboard<T = nil> = {

    --- If true, the artboard’s origin is treated as the frame origin.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: RenderInstance, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vm = Data.Character.new()
    ---
    ---   self.instance = self.character:instance(vm)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     self.instance.frameOrigin = true
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    frameOrigin: boolean,

    --- Draws the artboard using the provided renderer.
    --- ```lua
    --- type RenderInstances = {
    ---   character: Input<Artboard<Data.Character>>,
    ---
    ---   instance: Artboard<Data.Character>?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: RenderInstances, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vm = Data.Character.new()
    ---
    ---   self.instance = self.character:instance(vm)
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function draw(self: RenderInstances, renderer: Renderer)
    ---   local instance = self.instance
    ---
    ---   if instance then
    ---     renderer:save()
    ---     instance:draw(renderer)
    ---     renderer:restore()
    ---   end
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<RenderInstances>
    ---   return {
    ---     character = late(),
    ---     instance = nil,
    ---     init = init,
    ---     draw = draw,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    ---
    --- With a `visitor`, each drawable that has custom properties is handed
    --- to it instead of being drawn: the visitor decides whether to call
    --- `drawable:draw(renderer)` and under what renderer state. Whatever it
    --- sets on the renderer ends with that visit. Every other drawable draws
    --- as usual, and clipping still applies. `context` is passed through to
    --- the visitor untouched.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- In init: local GLOW = artboard:propertyKey("glow")
    --- -- Draw only the drawables tagged `glow`, in their own paint.
    --- artboard:draw(renderer, function(context, drawable, renderer)
    ---   if drawable:boolean(GLOW) then
    ---     drawable:draw(renderer)
    ---   end
    --- end)
    --- ```
    ---
    --- Drawing a tagged nested artboard visits the tagged drawables inside
    --- it from within that `drawable:draw` call, so a value carries down in
    --- a local:
    --- ```lua
    --- local level = 1
    --- artboard:draw(renderer, function(context, drawable, renderer)
    ---   local outer = level
    ---   level = outer * math.min(drawable:number(EMISSIVE) or 0, 1)
    ---   local c = math.floor(level * 255)
    ---   renderer:setColorModulation(Color.rgba(c, c, c, 255))
    ---   drawable:draw(renderer)
    ---   level = outer
    --- end)
    --- ```
    draw: (self: Artboard<T>, renderer: Renderer, visitor: ((context: any, drawable: Drawable, renderer: Renderer) -> ())?, context: any?) -> (),

    --- Draws the artboard with the color modulation set, per drawable, from
    --- its custom property of this key: a number as a gray level clamped to
    --- 0..1, a color as is. Drawables without it draw under the renderer's
    --- current state. Levels multiply down through tagged drawables that
    --- hold others: inside a nested artboard tagged 0.5, a shape tagged 0.2
    --- draws at 0.1 and an untagged one at 0.5. Nothing calls back into the
    --- script, so this is the cheapest way to draw a pass like emission.
    --- ```lua
    --- -- In init: local EMISSIVE = artboard:propertyKey("emissive")
    --- -- Everything black except drawables tagged `emissive`.
    --- renderer:save()
    --- renderer:setColorModulation(Color.rgba(0, 0, 0, 255))
    --- artboard:drawModulated(renderer, EMISSIVE)
    --- renderer:restore()
    --- ```
    drawModulated: (self: Artboard<T>, renderer: Renderer, key: PropertyKey) -> (),

    --- The key custom properties called `name` are read by. When no
    --- property in the file carries that name the key matches nothing, so
    --- every read by it comes back nil. Custom properties are added to a
    --- drawable in the editor's inspector.
    propertyKey: (self: Artboard<T>, name: string) -> PropertyKey,


    --- Advances the artboard by the given time in seconds. Returns true if the
    --- artboard should continue receiving advance calls.
    --- ```lua
    --- type RenderInstances = {
    ---   character: Input<Artboard<Data.Character>>,
    ---
    ---   instance: Artboard<Data.Character>?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: RenderInstances, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vm = Data.Character.new()
    ---
    ---   self.instance = self.character:instance(vm)
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- function advance(self: RenderInstances, seconds: number): boolean
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     return self.instance:advance(seconds)
    ---   end
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<RenderInstances>
    ---   return {
    ---     character = late(),
    ---     instance = nil,
    ---     init = init,
    ---     advance = advance,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    advance: (self: Artboard<T>, seconds: number) -> boolean,

    --- The typed data associated with the artboard.
    --- ```lua
    --- function init(self: RenderInstance, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vm = Data.Character.new()
    ---
    ---   self.instance = self.character:instance(vm)
    ---
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     self.instance.frameOrigin = true
    ---
    ---     local data = self.instance.data
    ---     if data then
    ---       print(data.nickname)
    ---     end
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   return true
    --- end
    --- ```
    read data: T,

    --- Creates a new instance of the artboard with independent state.
    --- ```lua
    --- type ViewModelExample = {
    ---   character: Input<Artboard<Data.Character>>,
    ---   instance: Artboard<Data.Character>?,
    --- }
    ---
    --- function init(self: ViewModelExample, context: Context): boolean
    ---   local vm = Data.Character.new()
    ---   self.instance = self.character:instance(vm)
    ---   return true
    --- end
    ---
    --- return function(): Node<ViewModelExample>
    ---   return {
    ---     character = late(),
    ---     instance = nil,
    ---     init = init,
    ---   }
    --- end
    --- ```
    instance: (self: Artboard<T>, viewModel: ViewModel?) -> Artboard<T>,

    --- Creates an animation instance linked to the artboard instance
    animation: (self: Artboard<T>, name: string) -> Animation?,

    --- The width of the artboard.
    --- ```lua
    --- self.instance = self.character:instance(vm)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     print(self.instance.width)
    ---   end
    --- end

    width: number,

    --- The height of the artboard.
    --- ```lua
    --- self.instance = self.character:instance(vm)
    ---   if self.instance then

    --- end

    height: number,

    --- Returns the bounding box of the artboard as two `Vector` values: the
    --- minimum point and the maximum point.
    --- ```lua
    --- local minPt, maxPt = self.instance:bounds()
    --- print("Bounds width", maxPt.x - minPt.x)
    --- print("Bounds height", maxPt.y - minPt.y)
    --- ```
    bounds: (self:Artboard<T>) -> (Vector, Vector),

    --- Returns the node with the given name, or nil if no such node exists.

    --- if self.instance then

    --- Pointer event down handler. Returns a hit-test result (0 = no hit).
    --- Only returns a non-zero value if a hit-testable object inside the nested
    --- artboard is hit.
    --- ```lua
    --- function handlePointerDown(self: PointerExample, event: PointerEvent)
    ---   if self.instance then
    ---     local hit = self.instance:pointerDown(event)
    ---     if hit ~= 0 then
    ---       print(event.id)
    ---       print(event.position)
    ---     end
    ---   end
    --- end
    --- ```

    --- Adds the artboard’s geometry to the given path, optionally transformed
    --- by the provided matrix.
    ---
    --- For a complete working example, see the [Add to Path](https://rive.app/community/files/27188-51290-add-to-path-scripting-demo?utm_source=docs&utm_medium=scripting_api&utm_campaign=docs_to_marketplace_links) demo.
    --- ```lua
    --- function draw(self: AddToPathExample, renderer: Renderer)
    ---   local instance = self.instance
    ---   if not instance then
    ---     return
    ---   end
    ---
    ---   -- Draw the artboard normally first.
    ---   renderer:save()
    ---   instance:draw(renderer)
    ---   renderer:restore()
    ---
    ---   -- Reset the path each frame, then rebuild it from the artboard's geometry.
    ---   self.outlinePath:reset()
    ---
    ---   -- Add the artboard's geometry into the path with an optional transform.
    ---   -- Here we apply a slight offset via Mat2D to show the transform parameter.
    ---   local transform = Mat2D.withTranslation(8, 8)
    ---   instance:addToPath(self.outlinePath, transform)
    ---
    ---   -- Draw the extracted path with a custom stroke paint as an outline / shadow effect.
    ---   renderer:drawPath(self.outlinePath, self.outlinePaint)
    --- end
    --- ```
    addToPath: (self:Artboard<T>, path:Path, transform:Mat2D?) -> (),

    gamepadConnected: (self: Artboard<T>, event: GamepadConnected) -> number,
    gamepadEvent: (self: Artboard<T>, event: GamepadEvent) -> number,
    gamepadDisconnected: (self: Artboard<T>, event: GamepadDisconnected) -> number,
}
